name: Front
title: front.com
shortDescription: Front is an all-in-one support platform designed to enhance customer service by integrating every communication channel into a single inbox. It is tailored for teams that require collaborative tools to manage shared inboxes, providing personalized service at scale. Example use case includes businesses needing to streamline their customer support operations, improve response times, and leverage AI for real-time insights.
cons: May be complex to set up
Potentially high cost for small teams
